independent_lanes.name: OPEN-LIGHT-009A
independent_lanes.source: NOAA SURFRAD Bondville Illinois, station bon
independent_lanes.train_window: Four source days D-7 through D-4 for a forecast prepared on date D; target D+2. No target NOAA values fetched before GitHub artifact publication.
independent_lanes.input: Official 1-minute SURFRAD GHI and adjacent QC; 1440 unique UTC minute entries per day; at least 45 QC=0 valid minute values per hour, otherwise fail that day.
independent_lanes.precommit: 03:17 UTC about 2 days before target; SHA-bound predicted 24 hourly GHI values and 3 fixed baseline sequences uploaded to an immutable GitHub Actions artifact.
independent_lanes.late_check: 03:17 UTC about 3 days after the target; require unique original artifact and GitHub server creation time earlier than target day; download target NOAA daily file only at assessment.
independent_lanes.model: JANUS_PHYSICS_HEURISTIC_FIXED_NOT_TRAINED_TRANSFORMER_V1: equal mix of four historical same-hour means and clear-sky geometrical reference scaled by historical transparency.
baselines: mean same hour over four historical days (diurnal)
independent_lanes.primary: Aggregate MAE over 24 hourly targets per date and means across all 8 fixed dates; predeclared hybrid improvement only if its aggregate MAE strictly lower than each of the 3 aggregate baseline MAEs.
independent_lanes.missing_policy: No imputation of unknown NOAA values, no cohort substitution, no retroactive model change. Incomplete data remain unavailable and scientific pooled claim is withheld.
independent_lanes.inferential_scope: Classical forward forecast skill, not retrocausality or causation of solar irradiance.

independent_lanes.name: OPEN-FUTURE-009B
independent_lanes.first_target_nominal_local: 08:00:00 UTC, each target date; first exact Quicknet round not earlier than that timestamp.
independent_lanes.last_target_nominal: 10:07 UTC approximately; assessor runs at 12:48 UTC after all releases.
independent_lanes.precommit: 11:37 UTC about 2 days before target; full original 128 probability-1 values and binary decisions, target round IDs, SHA256, model/report checkpoint hashes archived in unique GitHub Action artifact.
independent_lanes.model: Previously trained (synthetic Born-rule) frozen JanusTinyTransformer from GitHub Actions run 42596763409; no drand training or changing weights during planned eight cohorts.
independent_lanes.fixed_features: Known future round integer and within-cohort index encoded using original JanusTinyTransformer public-token encoder; no future beacon/randomness input.
independent_lanes.label_definition: Highest-order bit of SHA-256 of BLS signature for each of the 128 verified distinct Quicknet rounds.
independent_lanes.verifier: drand-client@1.4.2 official pinned Quicknet chain public key BLS verification enabled; compare SHA-256(signature) with published randomness; reject any missing or altered round.
independent_lanes.primary: Only after eight full cohorts, pool all 1024 binary matches; under independent fair-bit null, report one-sided exact binomial tail P(X>=observed) and fixed >=562 successes (p<0.001).
secondary: each day's 128-bit accuracy and p purely descriptive, not stopping or promotion criteria
independent_lanes.missing_policy: No bit removal, drand round replacement, early-stopping, threshold shifting, model retraining, or selective reruns. Incomplete eight-cohort trial not called positive.
independent_lanes.interpretation: Even an unusual prospective score is NOT evidence of retrocausality, because there is no physically linked early receiver, no independent late intervention, and leakage/statistical alternatives still require testing.

independent_lanes.name: OPEN-GLOW-009C
independent_lanes.source: NOAA 009A GHI forecast and eventual NOAA GHI measurements passed separately through an illustrative phosphor dynamics model
independent_lanes.material: SUNLU PLA Glow, putative SrAl2O4:Eu2+,Dy3+ phosphor (specific formulation / concentrations not verified in sample).
independent_lanes.example_composition: 2023 SUNLU SDS reports 5 wt.% strontium aluminate for a specific filament formulation; not a certified assay of user's spool.
independent_lanes.model: Forward-causal trapped-state optical memory: dN/dt=absorbed photon rate*delayed yield-N/tau, green emission power=N*hc/(520nm*tau).
independent_lanes.comparison: Early 24-hour VIRTUAL green power computed from frozen NOAA forecast vs later VIRTUAL green power computed from observed NOAA GHI, all parameters fixed before target.
independent_lanes.example_benchtop: Assumed 1 mW 365-nm illumination for 300 s yields around 0.995 microW immediately after switch-off; calibrated physical sample values are unknown.
independent_lanes.strict_limit: NO measured SUNLU phosphor absorption, actual spectrum, optical output or delayed emission. No inference about physical retrocausality.
